node.title: Re: Having to manually escape quote character in args to "system"?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: AFAIK it isn't as easy for Perl to avoid the shell on Windows, and the [doc://system] docs do say "On Windows, only the system PROGRAM LIST syntax will reliably avoid using the shell; system LIST, even with more than one element, will fall back to the shell if the first spawn fails." So you might want to try system {$^X} $^X, ...;. Otherwise, there is [mod://Win32::ShellQuote], and I wrote an article about various other methods for running system commands, some of which also help you avoid the shell, [id://1180578|here]. In particular, newer versions of [mod://IPC::Run3] will automatically use [mod://Win32::ShellQuote] on Windows.
